title: Revisiting the Bobkov-Chistyakov-Götze theorem on approximately Gaussian marginals

paper.title:
Revisiting the Bobkov-Chistyakov-Götze theorem
on approximately Gaussian marginals
paper.abstract:
Abstract We study one-dimensional
marginals of an isotropic, log-concave probability measure in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} . We show that the Kolmogorov
distance between a typical marginal and the standard
Gaussian distribution is at most C / n C/n , for a universal constant C > 0 C>0 .
This bound is optimal in general, up to the value of the universal constant. It improves the Gaussian approximation bound of Bobkov,
Chistyakov and Götze by a logarithmic factor in the log-concave setting.
